svg.title: Aleutian Current: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 3300 km. OSW regional eastward Subarctic/Aleutian reference reach, 175 E to 140 W, following the circulation convention in Favorite (1967) Figure 27. Gates truncate the schematic and are selected by OSW; they are not current origin or termination. Westward Alaskan Stream, West Wind Drift/North Pacific Current, Bering branches and downstream Alaska/California branches are excluded. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate Subarctic schematic regional reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 108 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Favorite (1967), Fig. 27; OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
